trusted_offline_findings.context: During the initial LINE_RESET, before a legal read request. Candidate counted eight samples after any high bit without qualifying the request header.
Candidate changed output handling, but no successful functional repair was observed.

final_source_findings: Any high level can start the request counter; full A5 header and line reset are not qualified.
The final implementation clears output and output enable on falling edges, contrary to the explicit rising-edge/stability contract.
Final terminal execution confirms a bus ownership violation; this does not identify every latent defect.
